definitions.explanation: A pitcher taking the mound to pitch in a game. Literally "climbing the plate/mound." Takes する to mean to pitch in a game. By extension, also used figuratively for someone stepping up to take on a task.

examples.japanese: ⟦エース→エース：28537_eesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧{登板|とうばん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ace pitcher will take the mound today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登板|とうばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: He earned a win in his first pitching appearance of the season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先発|せんぱつ}{投手|とうしゅ}→先発投手：26597_senpatsutoushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れ→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧、⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{救援|きゅうえん}→救援：07864_kyuuen⟧{登板|とうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The starting pitcher fell apart, and the manager decided on an early relief appearance.

notes:
A baseball term for a pitcher entering a game. The opposite, being taken off the mound, is {降板|こうばん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登板|とうばん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take the mound; to pitch
- {初|はつ}{登板|とうばん}: one's first pitching appearance
- ⟦{救援|きゅうえん}→救援：07864_kyuuen⟧{登板|とうばん}: a relief appearance
- ⟦{先発|せんぱつ}→先発：17735_senpatsu⟧{登板|とうばん}: a starting appearance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {降板|こうばん}: leaving the mound — being pulled from the game (also used figuratively for stepping down from a role)
